Local media processing tasks / AIGC media tasks.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

SUBCOMMANDS:
  aigc                        AIGC asset generation (text/image to image/video) and async task
                              result query.
  transcode-image             Convert a local image to a web-safe JPEG/PNG file.
  crop-image                  Crop a display-oriented pixel rectangle from a local image.
  resize-image                Resize a local image, preserving aspect ratio when one dimension
                              is omitted.
  compress                    Compress a video file to a target resolution. Bitrate
                              auto-derives from resolution and codec when not given.
  trim-video                  Keep the source video interval [start,end), including
                              synchronized audio.
  trim-audio                  Keep the source audio interval [start,end).
  change-video-speed          Change a whole local video's playback speed and create a new
                              video.
  change-audio-speed          Change a whole local audio file's playback speed and create a new
                              file.
  rotate                      Physically rotate the displayed input video by 0, 90, 180, or 270
                              degrees and clear display rotation metadata.
  extract-frames              Extract display-oriented JPEG/PNG frames at exact timestamps or a
                              fixed interval.
  extract-audio               Extract the audio track from a video file.
  probe                       Probe a local audio, image, or video file and return stable
                              technical metadata.
  loudness                    Detect average and peak loudness of a local audio or video file.
  measure-box                 Measure a sticker or picture-in-picture media layout box without
                              creating a VE editor or Effect render instance.
  beats                       Detect music beat positions in a local audio or video file. Video
                              inputs are decoded to a temporary audio track in the runner.
  object-matting-track        Track an object in a local video and generate a complete
                              timestamped mask sequence without modifying any draft.
  asr                         Recognize speech from a local audio or video file and return ASR
                              sentences.
  vad                         Detect voice-active segments in a local audio or video file
                              (VAD).
  feature                     Extract deterministic L2 visual features from local media or
                              prepared image frames.
  translate                   Translate sentence-level JSON produced by media asr without
                              rerunning ASR.
  understand                  Analyze a local media file and return material understanding
                              metadata.

EXAMPLES
  $ lyra-cli media transcode-image --input /tmp/in.heic --output /tmp/out.jpg
  $ lyra-cli media crop-image --input /tmp/in.jpg --output /tmp/crop.jpg --left 100 --top 80 --width 640 --height 640
  $ lyra-cli media resize-image --input /tmp/in.jpg --output /tmp/small.jpg --width 1280
  $ lyra-cli media compress --input /tmp/in.mp4 --output /tmp/out.mp4 --width 1280 --height 720
  $ lyra-cli media trim-video --input /tmp/in.mp4 --output /tmp/clip.mp4 --start 1s --end 5s
  $ lyra-cli media change-audio-speed --input /tmp/in.m4a --output /tmp/fast.m4a --speed 1.5
  $ lyra-cli media rotate --input /tmp/in.mov --output /tmp/rotated.mp4 --degrees 90
  $ lyra-cli media extract-frames --input /tmp/in.mp4 --output-dir /tmp/frames --interval 1s --short-side 360
  $ lyra-cli media extract-audio --input /tmp/in.mp4 --output /tmp/out.m4a
  $ lyra-cli media measure-box --input /tmp/sticker --canvas-width 1080 --canvas-height 1920
  $ lyra-cli media aigc text2image --prompt "a cat portrait" --ratio 1:1
  $ lyra-cli media aigc image2video --first-image /tmp/first.png --prompt "camera push in"
  $ lyra-cli media aigc query --submit-id <submit_id> --download-dir /tmp/out
  $ lyra-cli media probe --input /tmp/in.mp4
  $ lyra-cli media loudness --input /tmp/audio.m4a
  $ lyra-cli media beats --input /tmp/song.m4a --output /tmp/beats.json
  $ lyra-cli media object-matting-track --input /tmp/clip.mp4 --seed-time 1s --output-dir /tmp/matting --seed-mask-rle-json '{"counts":[2,2],"size":[2,2]}'
  $ lyra-cli media asr --input /tmp/speech.m4a --language auto --output /tmp/asr.json
  $ lyra-cli media vad --input /tmp/speech.m4a --output /tmp/vad.json
  $ lyra-cli media feature --input /tmp/in.mp4 --frame /tmp/frame-0001.jpg --module quality --module shot
  $ lyra-cli media translate --input /tmp/asr.json --target-language zh-CN --output /tmp/asr.zh.json
  $ lyra-cli media understand --path /tmp/in.mp4 --prompt "analyze the main subjects and visual style"
LEARN MORE
  Use `lyra-cli media <subcommand> --help` for more information.
